dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible on the mid-dorsal region are several irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings. These structures exhibit soft, low-frequency gradient transitions from a dark outer boundary to a slightly lighter gray interior, with non-linear, fuzzy edge perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A single, large, high-intensity cluster of saturated white pixels is localized on the anterior neck/head region, characterized by high core pixel concentration and irregular, asymmetrical boundaries. Smaller, low-density pixel clusters are sparsely scattered along the lower lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the primary anterior high-intensity blob and the three most clearly defined mid-dorsal annuli form an irregular, elongated polygon with two obtuse internal angles relative to the seal's longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, localized region of high-contrast saturation on the anterior-lateral aspect creates a stark visual break from the surrounding low-intensity, matte-textured pixels.
